name: fold_predictions
grain: one row per segment_id x test_year x method (long format)
budget_selection: Walk the ordering and keep the longest prefix whose cumulative length_m does not exceed budget x the total length_m of that test_year's rows for the method. Stop at the first segment that would overflow; do not skip ahead to fill the gap.
invariants: every test_year contains all four methods
within a test_year every method ranks the same set of segment_ids, so every method receives the same length budget
actual_break and length_m are identical across methods for the same segment_id and test_year
champion rows are a copy of the predictions of metrics.json champion_method

columns.name: segment_id
columns.description: Stable pipe identifier; joins to Contract A segment_id

columns.name: test_year
columns.description: Historical Proof Mode year; joins to Contract A score_year

columns.name: method
columns.description: Ranking method; the champion's real name is metrics.json champion_method

columns.name: model_score
columns.description: Raw ranking score; larger means higher risk; not comparable across methods

columns.name: risk_percentile
columns.description: Within test_year and method, average-rank percentile of model_score; larger means higher risk; tied scores share a percentile

columns.name: confidence_label
columns.description: Evidence support for the segment from training years only; identical across methods within a test_year

columns.name: is_ood
columns.description: Unfamiliar or data-poor record: unseen/UNKNOWN material, missing age, or age outside the training range

columns.name: actual_break
columns.description: 1 if the segment had at least one recorded break during test_year; hide until the Proof Mode reveal

columns.name: length_m
columns.description: Segment length; the equal-budget selection unit
